offers_products.reason: Fee-based midstream services; no goods sold as main offering, only gathering, processing and transport of customers' hydrocarbons.

offers_services.reason: Gathering, compression, processing, transportation and water management services for Permian oil and gas producers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are over 90 oil and gas producers, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Producers operating in the Delaware Basin rely on its midstream services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing fee-based gathering and processing of producers' continuous production volumes, under long-term dedications.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mission-critical, fee-based midstream services for producing wells; volumes continue through downturns, though drilling growth may slow.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay frequent per-volume fees for gathering, processing and transport, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from pipelines, compression and processing plants, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are oil and gas producers in the Permian, largely sizable energy companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates pipelines, large compression horsepower, processing plants and water systems requiring ongoing capital investment.

notes: Cyclical demand is a judgment call: fees are volume-based, but producers' drilling can slow when oil prices fall.
